In today’s show, we will discuss:
1. Stroke in young adults: Why is the risk of stroke increasing among young adults under 40? What are the early warning signs of a stroke? What should you do if someone suffers a stroke in front of you? How can a stroke affect memory, behaviour and recovery? How is stroke treated & what can you do to prevent it? Guest: Dr. Nitin Kumar Rai, Consultant Neurologist, Kailash Hospital, Noida.
